Kai (Design): Quick UX check for the batch embeddings preview + rerank export modal. Main asks: inline CSV preview in modal, numeric alignment, and clearer export copy. Figma: https://figma.com/file/preview-embed :mag:

Ruth (Frontend): Inline CSV preview is doable. We'll show first 5 rows, render scores with 3 decimals, and allow users to toggle showing machine column names.

Sam (Product): Copy choices for primary export CTA: "Export CSV" vs "Download ranked CSV" vs "Download results". Which is least ambiguous?

Lia (A11y): Prefer "Download ranked CSV" because it implies ordering. Accessibility notes: preview table in modal must be navigable by keyboard and announced correctly. Add aria-label: "CSV preview: first 5 rows" and role=table with headers.

Ben (Data): Backend accepts ordered `fields` param; front-end should send fields in current UI order. Also recommend adding `decimal_places=3` param for CSV formatting.

Kai (Design): UX nit: align numeric score column to the right so comparing decimals is easier. Also show a small chip next to table title: "Model: text-embed-v2 (pinned)".

Ruth (Frontend): Will right-align numbers and add chip. For preview we can render a lightweight HTML table and a copy button that copies CSV for first 5 rows. Also wire the modal to show a small sample header: `id,query,match,score,rank,model`.

Sam (Product): Make the modal show a toggle: [ ] "Include machine field names (advanced)". Default off. And include a notice: "Scores range 01. Higher = more similar."

Lia (A11y): When users enable machine names, announce via aria-live: "Machine field names enabled". Also ensure the modal's primary button has aria-describedby linking to the model chip so screen readers read: "Download ranked CSV. Model: text-embed-v2 (pinned)"

Ben (Data): Suggest the CSV include a single commented meta line at top: `# model=text-embed-v2;exported_at=2026-03-01T12:00:00Z` for auditing. Parsers ignore `#` lines.

Ruth (Frontend): We'll include that meta line conditionally based on opt-in checkbox "Include export metadata" (default on). Also implement `delimiter` radio: Comma / Semicolon / Tab. Default = Comma.

Kai (Design): Small copy tweak for the helper under export button: "Downloads include similarity scores by default. Uncheck to omit scores." Short and clear.

Sam (Product): For filename default propose `projectname_export_YYYYMMDD_ranked.csv` and append `_with_context` if source text included. Users can edit name.

Lia (A11y): Keyboard flow: modal traps focus, Escape closes and returns focus to toolbar trigger. Toolbar should be a single tab stop; arrow keys cycle controls. Ensure all toggles have visible focus outlines in high-contrast mode.

Ruth (Frontend): Implementation notes: CSV preview uses client-side renderer, `fields` param drives both preview and final export. We'll send `fields` in UI order and `include_scores=true/false`. Back-end ticket INF-5321 created to support `decimal_places` and `meta` header.

assets-bot: Created INF-5321 "export: decimal_places + meta header" and attached this thread.

Kai (Design): Decision summary: primary CTA = "Download ranked CSV"; include inline CSV preview (first 5 rows) with right-aligned numeric scores; preview toggles for machine names + metadata; delimiter radio; default filename `projectname_export_YYYYMMDD_ranked.csv`. Lia will provide aria snippets; Ben will confirm backend params; Ruth to prototype modal. Reconvene after prototype. :+1:

Ruth (Frontend): I'll push a prototype branch and ping for review tomorrow.

Ben (Data): I'll add tests for `fields` ordering and the `meta` header.

Lia (A11y): I'll post exact aria labels/snippets in this thread by EOD.

Sam (Product): I'll finalize copy and confirm filename pattern by EOD.

Kai (Design): Thanks team! Drop any quick copy changes directly into the figma file.
